description: Defines data structures, classes, and interfaces for managing F1AP connection procedures between gNB-DU and CU-CP, including setup, reset, configuration update, and removal procedures.

classes.name: ocudu::odu::f1ap_connection_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing F1AP connection procedures between DU and CU-CP, including setup, reset, removal, and configuration updates.

classes.name: ocudu::odu::f1ap_interface_update_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the DU of CU-initiated F1AP interface management requests.

methods.name: connect_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Establishes connection between DU and CU-CP via F1-C interface.

methods.name: disconnect_from_cu_cp
methods.description: Disconnects the DU from CU-CP after a failed F1 setup.

methods.name: handle_f1_setup_request
methods.description: Handles the F1 setup request procedure, initiating setup and awaiting response.

methods.name: is_f1_setup
methods.description: Checks if the F1 interface has been set up with CU-CP.

methods.name: request_cu_context_update
methods.description: Notifies DU of CU-initiated context update requests.
